MALAYSIAN AVIATION COMMISSION ACT 2015

MALAYSIAN AVIATION COMMISSION (AVIATION SERVICES CHARGES) (AMENDMENT)
REGULATIONS 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by  section 46  and subsection 98(1) of the
Malaysian Aviation Commission Act 2015 [Act 771], the Commission makes the following
regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Malaysian Aviation Commission
(Aviation Services Charges) (Amendment) Regulations 2016.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2017.

Amendment of Second Schedule
2. The Malaysian Aviation Commis sion (Aviation Service s Charges)
Regulations 2016 [P.U. (A) 100/2016], which are referred to as the "principal Regulations"
in these Regulations, are amended by substituting for the Second Schedule the following
Schedule:
